response.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS avg_of_team_avg_loss_rate FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 AND l IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id) t;

assumptions.assumption: "Pass the 53-game mark" means g > 53 (strictly greater), not g >= 53.
Each team is identified by team_id alone (grouped across all years and leagues), and each manager_half row is one stint with equal weight in the team's average.
Rows with NULL l are excluded; g is non-null whenever g > 53. The outer average is an unweighted mean of the per-team averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Inclusive threshold: stints with g >= 53 are counted.
